Current UAlbany undergraduates can apply for admission to our combined undergraduate and graduate programs.

Terminology
STEM: Eligible F-1 nonimmigrant students with STEM degrees may apply for a 24-month STEM OPT extension.
Fully Online: The program can only be completed online. Visit our Online Learning website for more information.
Fully Online Option: The program can be completed either online or on-campus.
Partially Online: Some, but not all, of the program can be completed online.
